coreConclusion: Two real capabilities are missing: a host-local common reservation/launch owner honoured at BOTH actual allocation paths, and a real already-accounted parent able to create/assign/observe children before resume. No evidence proves either installed. Do not substitute more refusal stubs or a global VM drain.

allocationInterface.smallestUnit: One host-local allocation owner with reserve/start/observe/release operations shared by both manager roles and qualification, using existing ownership/durable primitives where applicable; not a router-only side flag. Implementation name is proposed, not existing.

joinPoint.manager: server.mjs:488-542: final synchronous pool checks + domains.set starting before backend.start; preserve this atomic local segment and feed its full exact reservation into shared owner. Awaiting cross-process acquisition requires repeating local checks afterward.
joinPoint.physicalEffects: wmi-launcher.mjs:1122 defineType1/New-CustomVM at414 and :1145 startAndRead/Start-VM: hold must remain valid through both allocation effects and asynchronous outcomes. Both 8091 and8095, and their direct POST /vms paths, must reach the same owner. A gateway-only token misses direct calls.
joinPoint.router: control.mjs:188-247 waiting closures are not admitted. Existing pending-head journal correctly precedes forwarding and stays until correlated backend reservation. Reuse identity correlation; do not count queue length as P or clear old pending records.

actualOperations: Acquire a bounded reservation atomically against fresh physical+commit availability, validated live floor >=18432, outstanding not-yet-reflected reservations and test budget. Bind owner incarnation/sequence, request/domain, physical+commit upper bounds and deadline. A manager then registers its full VM intent before actual create/start.

Every manager/direct launch must honour the held qualification budget; serialize or otherwise account the actual check-to-allocation interval across both processes. Keep outstanding start reservations even if RPC returns/timeout or owning manager dies. Unknown remains charged until independent exact VM/process correlation resolves it.

Existing running allocation stays represented by OS available memory; do not double-subtract guessed running totals. Starting/uncertain memory is charged fully; router head may be conservatively double-counted until exact epoch/id correlation. Other concurrent host work needs an explicit bound, not P=0.

A trusted creator queries/holds the actual live reservation object; envelope consumes this one-shot binding, not raw caller values. Either guarantee immutable upper bounds for the whole hold interval or revalidate incarnation/sequence/revocation at actual resume and through observation.

Expiry closes new launches and stops only the owned qualification tree; do not free the test reservation until its processes/unknown effects are settled. Never stop existing VMs merely to acquire capacity.
allocationInterface.scopeBoundary: Can cover the two managed APIs and all their WMI effects only once wired there. Arbitrary independent Hyper-V/admin consumers require an explicit controlled/covered interval or additional enforceable boundary; no source API can silently claim to constrain unrelated administrator actions.
allocationInterface.notYetProven: No installed shared owner/reservation hook, live account of all P/commit commitments, or enforceable coverage of direct/other allocations.

creatorInterface.existingCandidateParent: The already-running local manager is a possible long-lived parent, but present psrun.mjs:131 only uses node child_process.spawn(exe,... windowsHide,shell:false); :149-158 uses timeout/kill-request with unresolved status. It neither creates a suspended child nor assigns a preconfigured Job. No native Job creator API was found in the reviewed source. SSH/task configuration is not evidence of that capability.
creatorInterface.smallestRealAddition: A narrowly scoped native createQualificationChild operation in an already-accounted trusted parent, providing real CreateProcess suspended, Job configuration/assignment and retained process/Job handles. This must be an actual installed native binding/service capability, not Node spawn of another unbounded helper. Parent implementation/placement remains a choice requiring evidence; there is no demonstrated existing compatible parent to simply call.
functionalContract: Only exact pinned test executable/directory/phase and fresh nonce; real shared reservation acquired and linked to the invocation. Fixed-size parsing/output/handle lists and accounted incremental parent/kernel footprint; no arbitrary command executor.

Configure outer Job before creating/assigning/resuming the child; parent owns its non-inherited Job handle, wall deadline and bounded output pipes. Exact child handle/PID/creation recorded. Prove parent own lifetime/accounting separately; do not claim child self-check proves pre-entry timing.

Maintain a one-shot invocation record binding legitimate observer, exact wrapper and distinct descendant identities/provenance; observer mode cannot independently authorize a target from argv. Never pass test Job T to observer.

At timeout/error terminate only the owned job/tree; exact-process death/drain confirms release. Preserve uncertainty and reservation on unresolved outcomes. The requested action is test execution only, no running app manager shutdown.
notSufficient: New standalone creator with unbounded startup renamed bootstrap
PowerShell timeout or SSH disconnect as death proof
Observed aggregate384 Job cap described as independently enforced wrapper64
Caller handle identity or directory-name nonce alone as target authorization

currentInstalledProofRequired: For listeners8091/8095/8097: exact PID+creation, executable hash, startup entry/role, manifest/config pins and effective role/ports; before/after identity stability. Read only selected public fields and hashes, never raw env/credentials.

Bind each running process to its actual bootstrap/imported module closure: main.mjs, server.mjs, backend, wmi-launcher.mjs, psrun.mjs and router control/io/platform. On-disk matches alone do not prove a previously loaded Node module; require startup measurement/immutable release continuity or equivalent process-bound evidence.

Pin actual Hyper-V module/helpers containing New-CustomVM and Start-VM, effective manager memory pools/live floor and known direct launch entrypoints. Identify parent creator process executable/creation and actual Job constraints/capabilities; no service-name or task-SYSTEM inference.

Refresh authoritative same-epoch manager inventory and durable router head, physical+commit counters and actual reservation coverage. Independent creator incremental E/O/non-job overhead must be bounded, not defaulted to zero.

deploymentBoundary.sourceImplementation: Implement the functional shared allocation owner + actual native parent creator, with real consumer tests. Separate from current refusal-only envelope. No further broad author is prepared here.
deploymentBoundary.installation: Current bootstrap imports modules once, and no existing live replacement hook was found. Writing new files does not change resident manager functions. Need a proven in-process extension/upgrade facility or separately engineered serving-manager ownership handover before claiming installation without downtime. Do not restart serving managers by assumption: existing recovery can lose relay/readiness.
deploymentBoundary.nativeQualification: Only after actual integrated parent/reservation implementation, installed source binding and fresh bounded admission are proven may one isolated disposable TEST run qualify actual Job/EXLOCK behavior. Build/import inspection is not that proof.
deploymentBoundary.existingVMs: Keep running VMs/relays/readers, ownership and journals untouched. No global drain needed for pre-admission queues. If no non-disruptive installation path exists, report that gap instead of silently stopping apps.
